name: billnotch
description: Track, report and invoice your time in BillNotch without leaving Claude Code. Sessions are logged automatically; skills cover logging time, timesheets, invoice drafts and cleaning up uncategorized hours.

api_key.title: BillNotch key
api_key.description: A Claude Code key from BillNotch: Settings, Devices, Connect Claude Code. Starts with tt_.

auto_track.title: Track Claude Code sessions automatically
auto_track.description: Logs the time you spend working with Claude Code as time entries. Only the folder name and git branch are sent, never prompts, code or file names.

idle_minutes.title: Idle cutoff (minutes)
idle_minutes.description: A gap longer than this between prompts ends the current block of tracked time.
